shared_elements: face with eyes, nose, mouth rendered frontally or in profile
large stone head/bust as the dominant single subject
justification: Both depict a single male head wearing a close-fitting or conical headdress as the sole dominant subject filling the field, with hair/beard framing the face — a fairly specific correspondence in subject. However, A is a low relief in strict profile with elaborate, highly patterned rows of curls, a fringed cap and a detailed shoulder/wing-like element, whereas B is a frontal, three-dimensional head with plain, schematic, undecorated surfaces and no accompanying body elements.
